place_fields.summary: Malpe Beach is described as a primary family and toddler beach with clean white sand, a gentle slope and a paved sea walk; a separate itinerary describes an easy 200 m stroll from the resort to the beach jetty/sea walk.

Padubidri Blue Flag Beach is identified in GitHub travel data as a coastal destination in Udupi and as a nearby attraction to other coastal sites; the request identifies it as the Blue Flag beach at Padubidri.

Paradise Isle Beach Resort is identified in GitHub travel data as a real, correctly located 75-room 4-star beach resort on Malpe Beach near Udupi, and other repository data places it in Malpe, Udupi, Karnataka.

planning_attributes.description: Beachfront resort on Malpe Beach with sea views, pool and easy access to St. Mary’s Island.
